summary: Completed backend + frontend regression for admin wallet balance consistency. Verified canonical admin auth, /api/auth/me and /api/admin/wallet/users alignment on EUR/BLZ, self-topup BLZ persistence with restore, and Admin Wallet UI search no longer showing stale huge EUR value.

integration_issues.issue: OPTIONS /api/auth/login response at preview edge still returns wildcard access-control-allow-origin: * even though app middleware is credentialed-origin aware. This matches known upstream ingress behavior and was non-blocking for tested flows.

action_items: No functional fix required for requested wallet inconsistency scope; contracts passed.
Optional platform follow-up: keep monitoring preview ingress CORS OPTIONS behavior for credentialed auth preflight consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: File size maintainability risk: /app/frontend/src/App.js is 1300+ lines (>700 guideline). Split route configuration into focused modules to reduce regression risk and improve testability.
Test side-effect awareness: brute-force lockout verification can temporarily block subsequent UI login tests for canonical admin unless lockout state is cleared first in test setup/teardown.
test_credentials: Used from /app/memory/test_credentials.md: admin@bidblitz.ae / BidBlitz2026!, admin@bidblitz.com / BidBlitz2026! (expected reject).
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Temporary BLZ +1 self-topup test was restored via matching debit -1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression coverage added for admin wallet consistency and auth lockout contract in test_iter190_admin_wallet_consistency.py. UI verified on /admin/wallet shows admin@bidblitz.ae with 7830.97€ and 0 BLZ; stale 2622000000.00€ value not visible.
rca of the issue: Original inconsistency came from reading admin-wallet balances from a stale wallets source instead of canonical users.balance/users.balance_blz. Current behavior is consistent across /api/auth/me, /api/admin/wallet/users, self-topup, and UI search.
